# Disposition Methods: Update a Disposition Method History Record

Area overview and notes: [disposition-methods.md](../disposition-methods.md)

`PATCH /accounts/{id}/disposition-methods/history/{history_id}` · tenant-scoped token

Update a disposition method history record for a given account.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |
| `history_id` | The unique identifier for the disposition method history record. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disposition_method` | string | No | The disposition method. One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`. |
| `effective_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 formatted date as the effective date of the disposition method. |

Example request body:

```json
{"disposition_method":"HIFO","effective_datetime":"2020-12-31T23:59:59Z"}
```

**Response 204**: Disposition Method History Record updated successfully

**Errors:** 400 Validation Error response that can contain either a single error message or an array of error messages. · 404 Not Found
